traditional.englishDescription: Being passed on from previous generations in a group or community.

trafficker.definitionKo: 법을 어기면서 몰래 물건을 파는 사람.
trafficker.englishDescription: A person who sells goods, secretly and illegally.

tree.definitionKo: 단단한 줄기에 가지와 잎이 달린, 여러 해 동안 자라는 식물.
tree.englishDescription: A plant with a hard stem, branches and leaves.
A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the number of trees.

trend.englishDescription: A change of a certain situation or phenomenon.

trend.definitionKo: 개인이나 집단의 사상이나 활동, 일이 되어 가는 형편 등이 움직여 가는 방향.
trend.englishDescription: The direction toward which an individual or a group's ideas, activities, tasks, etc., move.

trend.definitionKo: 무엇이 사람들에게 인기를 얻어 사회 전체에 널리 퍼짐.
trend.englishDescription: The state of something gaining popularity among people and being widely spread to an entire society.

trend.definitionKo: 시간이 지나면서 일이나 상황이 변함. 또는 그 변하는 모습.
trend.englishDescription: The state of an incident or situation changing over time, or such a change.

trend.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 현상이 일정한 방향으로 나아가는 경향.
trend.englishDescription: A tendency of a certain incident or phenomenon progressing into a fixed direction.
A trend and habit of certain times.
The fashion and habit of a certain past period.

trend.definitionKo: 시대에 따라 달라지는 세상의 상태나 형편.
trend.englishDescription: The state or situation of the world, that is changed by the times.

trend.definitionKo: 어떤 시대의 전체에 걸쳐 나타난 사상의 흐름.
trend.englishDescription: A current of idea that prevails throughout a certain period.
The development in trends that occurs with the passage of time.

troublemaker.englishDescription: (teasing) A person who behaves in a thoughtless and frivolous way.
A person who often causes problems.

troublemaker.definitionKo: 지능, 성격, 행동 등이 보통 아이들과 달리 문제가 되어 따로 지도와 교육이 필요한 아이.
troublemaker.englishDescription: A child who needs  individual guidance and education because his/her intelligence, personality, behavior, etc., is a problem.

troublemaker.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 늘 사고나 말썽을 일으키는 사람.
troublemaker.englishDescription: (disparaging) A person who always causes accidents or trouble.

tuna.definitionKo: 몸은 3미터 정도이고 등이 푸르며 살이 검붉은, 주로 회나 통조림으로 먹는 바닷물고기.
tuna.englishDescription: A type of sea fish with a blue back that can grow up to 3 meters long; its flesh is dark red and is mainly canned or eaten as sashimi.

tune.englishDescription: The flow of the highs and lows of a tune in music.
The melody of music or lyrics.
A tune of music or a song.
The flow of a piece of music or song.

tune.definitionKo: 길고 짧거나 높고 낮은 소리가 어우러진 음의 흐름.
tune.englishDescription: The flow of long and short or high and low notes.

tune.definitionKo: 노래 등을 제 박자와 음정에 맞게 부르다.
tune.englishDescription: To sing a song, etc., in measured time and in good pitch.

tune.definitionKo: 소리의 높낮이와 강약, 빠르기 등의 정도.
tune.englishDescription: The pitch, stress, tempo, etc., of sounds.
The accuracy and purity of pitch.
The tune of sound and music.
To adjust something to meet a certain standard.

tune.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 남이 어떤 일을 하도록 부추기는 일.
tune.englishDescription: (figurative) The act of instigating others to do something.

tune.definitionKo: 악기의 소리를 기준이 되는 음에 맞게 조정하다.
tune.englishDescription: To adjust a musical instrument to a standard pitch.

tussle.definitionKo: 운동 경기나 전투 등에서 두 편이 뒤섞여 어지럽게 싸움.
tussle.englishDescription: A state in which two teams in a sport game or troops in a battle are mixed and fight in a chaotic way.

tussle.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 서로 뒤섞여 어지럽게 싸우다.
tussle.englishDescription: For many people to fight in a violent and chaotic way.

tussle.definitionKo: 서로 머리나 멱살을 잡고 싸우는 짓.
tussle.englishDescription: A fighting in which two people grab each other roughly by the hair or by the collar.

tussle.definitionKo: 서로 옳으니 그르니 하며 자기주장을 고집하여 다투는 일.
tussle.englishDescription: The act of people arguing with each other, holding fast to their own positions while faulting those of others.

unfairness.definitionKo: 손해나 이익이 어느 한쪽으로 치우쳐 올바르지 않음.
unfairness.englishDescription: A state of being unfair as losses or interests are one-sided.

unfairness.definitionKo: 손해나 이익 등이 고르지 못하고 어느 한쪽으로 치우침.
unfairness.englishDescription: A state in which losses or interests are unfair and one-sided.

unjustly.englishDescription: In an unjust manner, which is against reason.
In a very absurd and unreasonable manner.

unrestrained.definitionKo: 체면이나 규범 등에 얽매이지 않고 마음대로이다.
unrestrained.englishDescription: Behaving as one likes, without being bound by rules or without caring about decency.

unskilled.englishDescription: Not being accustomed to or not good at something.
Not being accustomed to or not good at something.
Being unfamiliar and clumsy with something.
Poor at something because one has never done it.

unskilled.definitionKo: 말이나 행동이 익숙하지 않아서 서투르고 어색하다.
unskilled.englishDescription: One's way of speaking or behaving being clumsy and awkward because one is not accustomed to something.

virgin.definitionKo: 남자와 성적 관계를 한 번도 맺지 않은 여자.
virgin.englishDescription: A woman who has never engaged in sexual intercourse with a man.

virgin.definitionKo: 여자와 성적 관계가 한 번도 없는 남자.
virgin.englishDescription: A man who has never engaged in sexual intercourse with a woman.

virgin.definitionKo: 이성과 한 번도 성관계를 하지 않고 그대로 지닌 순결. 또는 그런 사람.
virgin.englishDescription: A person who has never had sex, or his/her status as a virgin.

virgin.definitionKo: 여자와 한 번도 성관계를 하지 않은 남자.
virgin.englishDescription: A male that has never had sex with a female.

virgin.definitionKo: 남자와 한 번도 성관계를 하지 않은 여자.
virgin.englishDescription: A female that has never had sex with a male.

virgin.definitionKo: 남자와 성적 관계가 한번도 없는 여자.
virgin.englishDescription: A female that has never had sex with a male.

virgin.definitionKo: 여자와 성적 관계가 한번도 없는 남자.
virgin.englishDescription: A male who has never had sex with a female.

wages.englishDescription: Money received in return for work.
Amount of money received in return for work.

waist.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물의 신체에서 갈비뼈 아래에서 엉덩이뼈까지의 부분.
waist.englishDescription: The part between the ribs and hip bones in the human or animal body.

waning.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 새로운 것에 밀려 점점 몰락해 감.
waning.englishDescription: (figurative) A state in which something is gradually collapsing, outpaced by a new thing.

wastepaper.definitionKo: 글을 잘못 써서 못 쓰게 된 종이.
wastepaper.englishDescription: Unusable paper because something incorrect has been written or printed on it.

wealth.englishDescription: A lot of property or possessions.

wealth.definitionKo: 한 국가나 사회가 가지고 있는 자본, 생산물, 자원 등 재산의 전체.
wealth.englishDescription: The entire wealth of a country or society such as capital, products, resources, etc.
(figurative) The state of having lots of money.

wealth.definitionKo: 재물의 힘. 또는 많은 재물에 가짐으로써 얻는 힘.
wealth.englishDescription: The power of wealth, or the power gained from having a lot of wealth.

wealth.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 이루는 데 큰 도움이 될 만한 많은 돈이나 물건.
wealth.englishDescription: A lot of money or things that can make a considerable contribution to accomplishing a certain task.

whale.definitionKo: 몸집이 매우 크며 물고기처럼 생긴, 바다에 사는 동물.
whale.englishDescription: A huge, fish-like animal living in the sea.

willy-nilly.definitionKo: 일의 앞뒤 사정을 알아보거나 이야기하지 않고 바로.
willy-nilly.englishDescription: Right away, not trying to find out the situation or tell someone.

willy-nilly.definitionKo: 일의 앞뒤 사정을 알아보거나 이야기하지 않고 바로.
willy-nilly.englishDescription: Right away, not trying to find out the situation or tell someone.

wimp.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 겉보기와 다르게 신체적, 정신적으로 매우 허약한 사람.
wimp.englishDescription: (figurative) A person who is very weak physically or mentally even though he/she does not look like that outwardly.

wintering.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물, 식물 등이 여러 상태나 방법으로 겨울을 지내는 일.
wintering.englishDescription: An act of going through a winter season in various states or methods by people, animals, and plants.
The act of spending the winter.

wood.definitionKo: 집이나 가구 등을 만드는 데 사용하는 재목.
wood.englishDescription: The material used to build a house or to make furniture.

worry-free.definitionKo: 세상의 복잡한 일에 매이지 않고 조용하고 편안하게 삶.
worry-free.englishDescription: The state of living quietly and comfortably, free from complex worldly matters.

writing.englishDescription: An act of making a script, document, etc.

writing.definitionKo: 보통 학생들이 글 쓰는 실력을 기르기 위해 자신의 생각을 글로 씀.
writing.englishDescription: Writing one's thoughts to develop writing skills, usually by students.

writing.definitionKo: 생각이나 일 등의 내용을 글자로 나타낸 것.
writing.englishDescription: A state of expressing one's thoughts or affairs in words.
A system or act of writing characters.

writing.definitionKo: 생각이나 사실 등을 글로 써서 표현하는 일.
writing.englishDescription: Expressing a fact or one's thought by writing it down.
An act of expressing one's thought or feeling in the written language.
The act of creating a written work; a written work.

writing.definitionKo: 학생이 자기의 감상이나 생각을 글로 쓰는 일.
writing.englishDescription: A student's act of expressing his/her opinions or thoughts in writing.

writing.definitionKo: 주로 학술적인 글이나 책 등을 씀. 또는 그런 글이나 책.
writing.englishDescription: The act of mainly writing an academic article, book, etc., or such an article or book.
The act of writing letters or words.
An act of expressing something by writing it down.

xylophone.definitionKo: 대 위에 길이와 두께가 다른 나무토막을 음계 순서로 놓고 두 개의 채로 때리거나 비벼서 소리를 내는 악기.
xylophone.englishDescription: A musical instrument with short wooden pieces, different in length and thickness, placed on long rails in order of musical scales, which makes sound by beating or rubbing the pieces with two sticks.

yeot.definitionKo: 밥을 엿기름으로 발효시켜 물처럼 될 때까지 약한 불로 끓인 뒤 졸여서 만든 달고 끈적끈적한 음식.
yeot.englishDescription: A sticky sweet that is made by fermenting steamed rice with malt, heating the fermented rice at a low temperature until it becomes liquid and then reducing it to make it sticky.
